builds.name: Thunder in the Distance
builds.desc:
Reinhardt isn't a formidable mage knight just because of his magic; he's an expert swordsman as well. This build aims to take advantage of his sword's unique effect and improve his performance on either phase.
Weapon: Meisterschwert is Reinhardt's weapon of choice. It's effectively a souped up Brave Sword+, boasting three more Mt, but it also allows him to strike twice even on the enemy phase. That is to say, even if he gets attacked, he'll respond with two consecutive strikes just as if he initiated combat. This gives him an edge over other Brave weapon users who generally have no enemy phase presence due to their weapons only striking twice on the player phase.
Assist: Reposition is a good Assist in general to use. Its uses are versatile, as it can either help bring an ally closer to the fray, or bring an ally out of danger. Cavalry units put it to great use with their high Mov.
Special: Moonbow is Reinhardt's Special, which lets him pierce through an enemy's Def. However, he needs to have the Quickened Pulse Seal when using this skill, as he'd be able to activate it on the second strike. If the Seal is unavailable and Reinhardt is using a different Seal, then Luna would be preferred instead. It also lines up well with the rhythm of his attacks. He'll be able to strike twice and defeat an opponent, and his next victim will take two strikes, with the second hit having Luna charged.
A Passive: Distant Counter is Reinhardt's A skill. With it, he'll be able to retaliate against mages and most archers, and thanks to his weapon's effect, he'll respond with two consecutive strikes. This is to ensure that more fragile ranged foes won't be able to take advantage of Reinhardt, and will have to think twice before engaging him.
B Passive: Guard 3 is an option for his B skill, as it can help deter an opponent from charging their Special, letting Reinhardt safely take on units who rely on their Special. However, this skill slot is really flexible, as there are lots of other options he could put to good use. Vantage 3 is an interesting option, as he'll be able to strike first and strike twice when he's attacked while he's at a low enough health. This lets him get the jump on some foes and potentially surprise them. Hit and Run lets Reinhardt retreat after attacking, helping him return to his allies and stay in better formation. Chill Def 3 lets him debuff a tough opponent from afar, which either supports his team, or softens up his next target. Swordbreaker 3 lets Reinhardt smash through sturdier sword wielders. Whatever he uses is up to the player's discretion, as he should be fine with anything.
C Passive: Spur Atk/Def 2 is an option for Reinhardt's C skill, letting him augment an ally's Atk and Def, making them sturdier. However, this skill slot is flexible, as there are few other options he could use. Cavalry buffs like Goad Cavalry or Ward Cavalry could work, or even other regular buffs like Tactics skills could be used if he's not on a cavalry team. Def Smoke 3 could help Reinhardt pierce through more opponents. After any round of combat, whether he's initiating or retaliating, any nearby foe will suffer a Def debuff, letting him deal even more damage to them. Whatever he uses here is up to the player, as anything should be fine.
Sacred Seal: Quickened Pulse is necessary as Reinhardt's Seal if he is using Moonbow, as it helps bring the charge down to 1 so that he can activate it in his first engagement. Should it be in use or is unavailable, then a simple Atk boost with Attack +3 will help maximize his power on either phase, while Fierce Stance 3 will help improve his enemy phase power, especially if he has Vantage 3 to get the jump on his opponents.

builds.name: Lightning Strikes Twice
builds.desc:
For players who wish to use Reinhardt right out of the gate, he thankfully has an excellent base kit and works wonderfully with almost all of it, only requiring an offensive Special and an Assist. This build focuses on improving his player phase performance, but his enemy phase presence is decent enough as well.
Weapon: Meisterschwert is Reinhardt's weapon of choice. It's effectively a souped up Brave Sword+, boasting three more Mt, but it also allows him to strike twice even on the enemy phase. That is to say, even if he gets attacked, he'll respond with two consecutive strikes just as if he initiated combat. This gives him an edge over other Brave weapon users who generally have no enemy phase presence due to their weapons only striking twice on the player phase.
Assist: Reposition is a good Assist in general to use. Its uses are versatile, as it can either help bring an ally closer to the fray, or bring an ally out of danger. Cavalry units put it to great use with their high Mov.
Special: Luna is Reinhardt's Special, which lets him pierce through an enemy's Def. It also lines up well with the rhythm of his attacks. He'll be able to strike twice and defeat an opponent, and his next victim will take two strikes, with the second hit having Luna charged.
A Passive: Death Blow 3 is Reinhardt's A skill. As this build is geared more for player phase combat, this helps improve his Atk even further upon initiating combat, which can help him muscle through his opponents.
B Passive: Vantage 3 is an option for his B skill. With it, he'll be able to strike first and strike twice when he's attacked while he's at a low enough health. This lets him get the jump on some foes and potentially surprise them. This also ensures that if he is weakened, he's not down and out of the fight just yet. However, this skill slot is pretty flexible, as he's got a few other good options. Hit and Run lets Reinhardt retreat after attacking, helping him return to his allies and stay in better formation. Swordbreaker 3 lets Reinhardt smash through sturdier sword wielders. Whatever he uses is up to the player's discretion, as he should be fine with anything.
C Passive: Spur Atk/Def 2 is an option for Reinhardt's C skill, letting him augment an ally's Atk and Def, making them sturdier. However, this skill slot is flexible, as there are few other options he could use. Cavalry buffs like Goad Cavalry or Ward Cavalry could work, or even other regular buffs like Tactics skills could be used if he's not on a cavalry team. Whatever he uses here is up to the player, as anything should be fine.
Sacred Seal: Attack +3 is a simple attack buff, chosen to help maximize Reinhardt's power. However, his Seal is flexible, open to be whatever else he may need.
